description_en: Uploads text-type phase data to the blockchain after signing by an IoT device, and optionally binds associated phase data from other phases
description_zh: 通过IoT设备签名后，上传文本类型的阶段数据到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据
kebab_example: aliyun ltl upload-mpcos-phase-text-info-by-device --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --biz-chain-id 4899730875490000 --phase-group-id 9878230743340000 --phase-id 6442088875110000 --data-key 32bfce96b4e2f9bec0f2ea5cc2f14ace1486cc146d5832d3a84e5332fe890000 --phase-data '某公司某业务数据。' --iot-auth-type ID2 --iot-id 1833297615720000 --iot-id-source 2 --iot-id-service-provider 94894989498FDDABD51698BD1A49BF1AFB0AA94FAA8DB65A689164BEED000000 --iot-data-digest 94894989498FDDABD51698BD1A49BF1AFB0AA94FAA8DB65A689164BEED000000 --iot-signature '2~2~192ADFB498AA0000~1579198300000~J8E891NAgAhwHBHm8000000/hnswr698HSb09ahS8709bn9s03jg98u4jg000000' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfoByDevice

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data
parameters.name: data_key

parameters.help_en: The phase data. The length must be 1 to 4,096 bytes. Each Chinese character occupies two bytes
parameters.help_zh: 阶段数据。长度要求1~4096字节，一个中文字符占两位字符
parameters.name: phase_data

parameters.help_en: The list of related data. For more information, see the RelatedData table below
parameters.help_zh: 关联数据列表。详情请参见下表RelatedData
parameters.name: related_data_list

parameters.help_en:
The IoT authentication method.
ID2: Alibaba Cloud Link ID²
parameters.help_zh:
IoT认证方式。
ID2：阿里云Link ID²
parameters.name: iot_auth_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the IoT device
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The IoT device service provider.
1: open platform.
2: IoT Platform
parameters.help_zh:
IoT设备服务提供方。
1：开放平台。
2：物联网平台
parameters.name: iot_id_source

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the IoT device service provider
parameters.name: iot_id_service_provider

parameters.help_en:
The digest of the IoT trusted data value:
1: Encode the value data in UTF-8.
2: Perform SHA-256 hashing. Convert the 32-byte result to a 64-byte uppercase hexadecimal string
parameters.help_zh:
IoT可信数据Value摘要：
1：Value数据UTF-8编码。
2：SHA256运算，结果为32字节数据转换为64字节字符串格式（大写字符）
parameters.name: iot_data_digest

parameters.help_en:
The data signature of the IoT device.
Use the IoT device security SDK to generate the signature
parameters.help_zh:
IoT设备数据签名。
使用IoT设备安全SDK进行签名
parameters.name: iot_signature

Data.description_en: A redundant parameter. Ignore this parameter

Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
